classification.name: Certification
classification.description: Governed maturity and trust level assigned to real-estate data assets.

tags.name: Bronze
tags.description: Raw ingested data. Source-aligned, minimally transformed and not yet fully validated for analytical consumption.

tags.name: Silver
tags.description: Validated and standardized operational data suitable for controlled business use and downstream transformation.

tags.name: Gold
tags.description: Curated, governed and analytics-ready data suitable for trusted reporting, KPIs and business decision-making.
